applies_to: draft PR #62 isolated Windows CI and prior recorder observations; not installed on Tapo PC

cases.scope: CI-only Windows2022 patched GLib/GIO; registry versus nochange, 0-16 epochs
cases.observed: Original #45015173260 private +221184B, optional REGION +155648B, heap BUSY -7794B; three independent GIO16 runs corroborated signs, not owners. Synthetic Windows2022 calibration #45040046000: controlled test HeapAlloc64/HeapFree48, 16 expected outstanding; ETW started before workload, sequential capture, logger zero-loss checked, xperf totals+size360 stack action PASS. This is NOT a recorded actual exact-16 xperf table count nor any real GIO owner.
cases.why_previous_did_not_resolve: HeapWalk BUSY and REGION are different from PSAPI PrivateUsage; former only reports current blocks/selected regions. Prior ETW saved truncated top25 module frame occurrences, not matched allocation+free bytes or a complete call-site owner. Unproven worker quiescence biases endpoints. The corrected #45040046000 probe closes pre-workload event-start, circular overwrite, and missing local-symbol setup ONLY on a synthetic fixture. The filtered report has not yet been independently parsed into exact 16 outstanding / 5760 requested bytes and matching source stack, nor adapted to real GIO workload and global worker quiet boundary.
cases.missing_observable: Allocation IDs with matching frees and outstanding bytes grouped by sanitized module/source site on the same controlled lifetime boundary; commit movement by reserved/committed category, trace completeness and worker/APC idle provenance.
cases.next_automatic_action: FIRST: add a strict local-only parser for the now-working xperf -a heap -stacks -size 360 361 report from synthetic #45040046000; verify original 64 alloc / 48 frees / 16 outstanding, 5760 requested bytes and allowlisted synthetic allocating stack, with trace loss=0 and quiescent phase; fail closed if report cannot be mapped unambiguously. SECOND only after this discriminator passes: gate disposable GIO/WinRT process behind the same pre-workload handshake and no-loss sequential ETW; capture same-arm owner outstanding differences at a proven worker epoch. No host/camera, no long 256 rerun, no raw ETL export.
cases.decisive_rule: A valid capture with no loss, same workload, proven worker quiet boundary AND exact alloc/free-matched outstanding bytes by stable source stack across repeatable epochs supports LEAK_CONFIRMED if expected lifetime has ended. Pure commit growth with no outstanding allocation slope is a candidate BOUNDED_RETENTION, which separately needs repeat-load plateau proof. The 16 deliberately held synthetic blocks are NOT a leak. Missing xperf numeric table parsing or GIO quiet proof keeps EVIDENCE_GAP open.

cases.scope: Original uninstrumented four-arm 256-cycle Combo Windows2022 CI (not same as three GIO16 runs)
cases.observed: Combo settled control-adjusted PSAPI PrivateUsage +368640B; late192-256 +53248B. HeapWalk 360-byte size bin late controlled +5 blocks, size is not allocation owner.
cases.why_previous_did_not_resolve: Original 256-cycle evidence saved aggregate endpoint counters, but no source-owned outstanding allocation lifetime or complete per-heap commit census. Instrumented 16-cycle and later UST traces are different processes/workloads; they cannot be backfilled as original allocation owners.
cases.missing_observable: Complete same-arm alloc/free ownership and committed/freeable region accounting at a proven quiet boundary for the specific late residual, preserving the original SDK and workload identity.
cases.next_automatic_action: First close GIO16_OWNER_AND_COMMIT's attribution and capture-completeness gate. Only then decide whether a differentiated short CI experiment can answer the original late residual; if not, predefine one minimal same-configuration window with a clear discriminating trace. Never rerun original four-arm 256 solely to repeat counters.
cases.decisive_rule: Classify only with same-workload lifetime evidence identifying an owned outstanding source or repeatable bounded retention; older 360B counts alone cannot settle either case.

cases.scope: CI-only Windows registry callbacks and GIO worker/APC parser cleanup
cases.observed: Archived phase trace reports worker_active_after_cleanup=1 and boundary_tick_ambiguous=1; 0-18 paired windows are not globally quiescent.
cases.why_previous_did_not_resolve: A finished AppInfo update counter does not acknowledge not-yet-delivered APCs or globally drain other async producers. Timed wait and GObject count alone can produce false leak/plateau conclusions.
cases.missing_observable: Proven closed producer/consumer boundary, including callback arrivals, queued jobs, active worker count, update epoch completion and absence of delayed callback after snapshot.
cases.next_automatic_action: Use source audit to define and selftest an isolated deterministic quiescence acknowledgement for only the disposable CI experiment. Do not force cleanup/restart, change live DLLs or assume fixed sleeps prove idle.
cases.decisive_rule: Snapshot is valid for allocation lifetime classification only after all observed producer epochs are acknowledged, active workers=0 and a bounded verification barrier closes; if callbacks can still arrive, mark snapshot coverage incomplete and do not infer leak.

cases.scope: Real Windows10 Tapo dual RTSP, 1-hour MP4 split, current production PC versus not-yet-installed patched candidate
cases.observed: Original before-candidate 4-hour host CSV: Private +31.77 MiB, handles +3424 in same PID, CPU tracked; no new post-candidate host measurement.
cases.why_previous_did_not_resolve: CI simulates Windows2022 GLib workloads and synthetic RTP streams; it cannot prove the original Windows10 Japanese host's true RTSP/MP4 memory/CPU/handle stability or release file continuity. Prior 4h baseline predates candidate.
cases.missing_observable: After isolated candidate passes ABI/codec/MP4/EOS/security gates and explicit host approval, one integrated automatic real-host series with same PID, segment-relative phase, memory/handle/CPU trajectory, 1-hour split integrity and 2-stream AV continuity, including safe stop/restart.
cases.next_automatic_action: Complete all CI-only source ownership and regression analysis, define explicit before-test host-specific resource budget and a one-pass integrated collector using existing vetted diagnostics. Do not ask user now to repeat old 4h UMDH/WPR/handle tests.
cases.decisive_rule: Release is HOLD until explicit approval and real-host memory/CPU/handle nondivergence in comparable full hourly segments plus video/audio/sync/MP4/EOS quality gates; one short or simulated CI pass cannot qualify 24x365 operation.
